passages.text:
Re: Urgent Request: Remove Posts Threatening NDI-Libya Partner on Facebook
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Zabe Shafi Wednesday, July 20, 2022 at 3:16:59 AM Eastern Daylight Time
o: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Teddy Wilhite
Cс: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Khaled Koubaa, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Brian Giacometti, [contact omitted] Nathan Park,
[opaque block] [contact omitted] [opaque block] [contact omitted], [contact omitted] Brendan Wheeler
Hi Teddy,
Yes we are seeing that the page and posts have been removed. Thank you so much for your help and quick action!
We will continue to reach out to you if anything else comes up.
Best,
Zabe
On Tue, Jul 19, 2022 at 6:23 PM Teddy Wilhite - [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Zabe,
Just checking in to confirm the below page and posts were removed (we've actioned them so they should
be) - are you all seeing that on your end as well?
Do let us know if anything else pops up.
Teddy
From: Zabe Shafi < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, July 7, 2022 4:28 PM
To: Khaled Koubaa < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Teddy Wilhite [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Brian Giacometti < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Nathan Park <[contact omitted]>; [opaque block] [contact omitted]
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Brendan Wheeler <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Urgent Request: Remove Posts Threatening NDI-Libya Partner on Facebook
Hi Khaled,
It looks like the page has been taken down, thanks for your assistance. Unfortunately there's another Facebook page
that has put up an identical post, smearing H20 and their staff member, Marwa. We are unsure if the pages are run by
the same people or if this is a coordinated attack by several people.
Marwa shared with us that she received an official police report about her being a target of a hate speech campaign
(attached). The report names the person that ran the Facebook page that was shut down--Mohamed Moaigal.
We request that Facebook promptly investigates this matter and removes the post/shuts down the page. We expect
more of these attacks to take place and will continue to reach out to Facebook to address.
Thank you,
Zabe
On Mon, Jul 4, 2022 at 8:28 PM Brendan Wheeler <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Teddy and Khaled,
USAID/Libya is concerned to see that this page continues to post content that we believe is threatening to our
partners. We agree with NDI that is this an urgent matter. USAID/Libya also would appreciate an update on the
progress of the review your colleagues are conducting.
Thanks for your consideration.
Brendan

On Mon, 4 Jul 2022 at 4:39 PM Zabe Shafi < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
I'm sharing screenshots from the latest posts as well. Thank you for your assistance on this urgent matter.
On Mon, Jul 4, 2022 at 5:54 PM Zabe Shafi q [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Khaled,
Thank you for the quick response. Do you have any updates for us? The Facebook page is still active and we
remain very concerned for our partner's safety.
Thank you,
Zabe
On Sat, Jul 2, 2022 at 11:55 PM Khaled Koubaa < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Brendan,
Ialready forwarded the content to our team to investigate
I will get back to you if there is anything I can share.
Thankyou,
Khaled
From: Brendan Wheeler <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Saturday, July 2, 2022 10:53:02 PM
To: Teddy Wilhite < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Khaled Koubaa < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Nathan Park <[contact omitted]>; Brian Giacometti < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>; Zabe Shafi
[opaque block] [contact omitted]>; [opaque block] [contact omitted]< [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Fwd: Urgent Request: Remove Posts Threatening NDI-Libya Partner on Facebook
Teddy and Khaled,
USAID/Libya shares NDI's concerns about the content of these posts and the potential risks they pose to our
Libyan partner's safety.
We join NDI in requesting that Facebook take prompt action to remove these posts and suspend the page in
question.
We request that Facebook keep us updated on its actions in this matter.
Thankyou for your consideration.
Sincerely,
Brendan M. Wheeler
Democracy and Governance Officer
USAID/Libya
Libya External Office (Tunis)
.- Forwarded message -
From: Zabe Shafi < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Date: Sat, Jul 2, 2022 at 6:34 PM
Subject: Urgent Request: Remove Posts Threatening NDI-Libya Partner on Facebook
To: Teddy Wilhite < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Khaled Koubaa < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Brian Giacometti < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Kristi Arbogast < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Hi Teddy and Khaled
One of NDI's partners in Libya, H20, is receiving threats from this Facebook page, calling for a gathering at the
H20 office and posting pictures of road closures and tires burning. We are worried for the safety of our partner
organization and particularly the head of the organization, Marwa, who is specifically being targeted.

We kindly request Facebook's quick attention to this and action by removing these posts and suspending the
page. Please find attached specifics screenshots of the threats. We are happy to provide any additiona
information.
Thank you,
Zabe
Zabe Shafi
Senior Program Manager
Middle East and North Africa
National Democratic Institute
